descriptive_sigmoids.classification: post hoc descriptive regularized group sigmoids
descriptive_sigmoids.bootstrap_scope: Participant cluster percentile intervals conditional on chosen method and nonflat curves; method selection is not repeated. Boundary mass is reported separately. Bands include flat draws.
descriptive_sigmoids.formula: RT(d) = lower + amplitude * expit((d - midpoint) / width)
descriptive_sigmoids.parameter_definitions: width is logistic scale, not a Gaussian SD; normalized midpoint steepness = 1/(4*width), RT derivative = amplitude/(4*width), 10–90% span = 2*ln(9)*width
descriptive_sigmoids.selection: Smallest crossed person/position shape-prediction RMSE; one pipeline/hyperparameter set for all four curves. Post hoc tuning, no new significance test.

validation.target: Raw within-person mean at omitted position minus that person's mean of the other four positions
validation.caution: Method selection uses these scores; not an independent confirmatory prediction test. Fold errors are dependent.

sensitivity.expanded_bounds: Normalized midpoint [-0.5,1.5], width [0.01,2], amplitude [0,1000] ms; flags in this table refer to the main bounds.

shape_audit.criteria: At least 10–90% of the logistic amplitude inside 10–100 cm; at least two sampled positions on each side of the midpoint; at least one in the 20–80% transition; maximum departure from the best dense-grid line at least 5% of the fitted observed range; positive nonflat amplitude. These post hoc display/sampling thresholds are not a validated physiological PPS definition.

nested_prediction.scope: Six outer participant folds; five inner participant folds crossed with omitted positions. Each family selects extraction, smoothing and fitting using training participants only. Outer predictions also omit the target position from fitting. Inner selection sees all design positions in training participants. Evaluation conditions on profiles cleaned beforehand using each person's eligible AT and Baseline hit RTs across all positions. People do not share cleaning thresholds, but an omitted position can affect its own person's threshold. This is relative-profile prediction for new people at the known design, not end-to-end prediction from uncleaned trials; families/criteria were developed post hoc. Overlapping training sets preclude treating folds as independent replicates or this evaluation as a confirmatory test.

raw_curvature.method: Post hoc Hotelling T-squared on three orthonormal contrasts orthogonal to intercept and distance; raw unsmoothed participant means. Assumes independent people, multivariate-normal contrasts and nonsingular covariance. Holm correction across four curves. Detects any nonlinearity, not specifically an S shape; a large p value does not establish linearity.

shape_audit.interpretation: Shape-constrained curves satisfy the geometry by construction when nonflat. Their existence is not evidence that the measurements contain an S-shaped transition. Intervals condition on the selected pipeline and shape constraints. Neither smoothing nor display interpolation adds independent observed positions.

linkage_audit.interpretation: Matching recordings with different questionnaire records cannot establish independent participants. Preserve source rows; resolve the original mapping. New RT–questionnaire results are provisional; exclusion sensitivities do not identify the correct mapping.

participant_sigmoids.interpretation: All numbers are exploratory fitted proxies. Visible geometry is imposed, reverse responses are retained, and the original failed participant boundary gate is unchanged. Numeric midpoint/width values in flat or weak profiles reflect constraints/regularization, not identified physiological boundaries.
participant_sigmoids.normalization: Subtract the fitted lower plateau and divide by absolute fitted amplitude. This is an affine display transformation, not new evidence. Do not clip observations; skip zero amplitude and flag intervals containing zero. Joint sensitivity shares plateaus across each person's four curves.
participant_sigmoids.uncertainty: 500 fixed-record within-cell trial resamples for full-release parameters; 500 person/linked-record-group plus trial resamples with refitted pools for association and mean-contrast intervals in each of four linkage specifications. Conditional on cohort-specific selected method, original cleaning and constraints; no correction for method selection or within-cell serial dependence. 19,999 pairing permutations; all 126 p values per specification unadjusted. Unresolved linked records make full-release inference provisional; exclusions do not identify the correct mapping.
participant_sigmoids.selection_scope: 84 methods: 36 visible, 36 broad and 12 lines, plus a constant. Six outer participant/linked-record-group folds repeat tuning on training people, using omitted-position prediction; test-person fits use four positions and pooling from training people only. Linked copies are excluded together from each person's pool. Scores condition on earlier cleaning. Shared-plateau sensitivity uses the selected visible preprocessing and penalty.

prediction.scope: Six outer participant folds; five inner participant folds crossed with omitted positions. Each family selects extraction, smoothing and fitting using training participants only. Outer predictions also omit the target position from fitting. Inner selection sees all design positions in training participants. Evaluation conditions on profiles cleaned beforehand using each person's eligible AT and Baseline hit RTs across all positions. Overlapping training sets preclude treating folds as independent replicates or this evaluation as a confirmatory test.

raw_curvature.method: Post hoc Hotelling T-squared on three orthonormal contrasts orthogonal to intercept and distance; raw unsmoothed participant means. Assumes independent people, multivariate-normal contrasts and nonsingular covariance. All four p values unadjusted. group_shape.interpretation: Post-results exclusion-cohort audit. Nested scores compare five response families on the same cleaned-profile target. Log distance is not an expectancy control. Nine geometry specifications are all reported with frozen preprocessing; their leave-position scores are descriptive and use all people. Thirty repeated-selection resamples diagnose instability, not tail confidence coverage. Original cleaning is fixed; no serial-dependence or physiological validation is claimed.

questionnaires.status: exploratory; no questionnaire result is a validated PPS boundary

scoring.rule: Complete-subscale item means; reverse items 5–10, 11, 12, 15 as 5−response; no imputation or total score.

spatial.method: two-sided exact sign test, ties excluded from binomial denominator
spatial.interpretation: Higher means a higher A–H code; administered pictogram anchors are unavailable.

questionnaires.administration: Owner-confirmed: MAIA-2 once before the experiment; spatial-frame ratings after each intervention. Timing is not reconstructed from CSV timestamps.

delta_analysis.definition: Viscereality post-intervention code minus Control post-intervention code, irrespective of presentation order
delta_analysis.comparison_count: 42 rank correlations (9 numerical-delta and 33 retained earlier comparisons); 16 moderation fits, each with classical and HC3 inference; one overall paired sign test. No multiple-testing correction.
delta_analysis.scope: Post hoc pre-experiment trait moderation, not mediation. Code differences assume comparable category steps. Direction-only correlations are ordinal sensitivities; earlier absolute-rating results are supplementary. Correlation and interaction models are not independent replications.
delta_analysis.model: Participant delta ~ intercept + centred MAIA, with/without centred Viscereality-first (0=Control-first, 1=Viscereality-first). Each subscale fitted separately. Beta estimates Condition × MAIA in code steps per MAIA point; F=t² with (1,n-k) df. HC3 uses t tails with n-k df as an approximate sensitivity. Order adjustment does not eliminate carryover.

resampling.reporting_change: Unadjusted reporting requested after inspecting the association results; all 33 comparisons retained as exploratory.
resampling.scope: Two-sided permutation test of independence; pointwise paired-person percentile 95% intervals with re-ranking; undefined bootstrap draws excluded and counted. No covariate adjustment.

limitations: Exploratory extension; exact questionnaire wording in the registration could not be retrieved (HTTP 403).
MAIA-2 measures self-reported interoceptive dimensions, not objective interoceptive accuracy.
Alpha describes internal consistency under restrictive assumptions; it does not establish unidimensionality or validity. No item deletion or factor-model claim.
A–H ordering is preserved, but pictogram anchor direction is unverified. Timing was confirmed by the owner; administered language remains undocumented.
Numerical spatial-code differences assume comparable category steps; Spearman ranking and HC3 uncertainty do not remove that measurement assumption.
No repeated MAIA, perceived-body-boundary or small-self fields are released. Boundary-related correlations remain gated.
Small sample, multiplicity, ties, unadjusted confounding and uncertain behavioural contrast reliability limit association interpretation.

unavailable_checks: Waveform cue-time and RT-onset validation: original recordings are not in the released CSVs.
Measured respiratory compliance: phase labels are scheduled/instructed, not belt-verified.
Pilot dates, acquisition-version effects and two source-onset exclusions: required provenance metadata are not released.
interpretation: Recording-linkage audit: unresolved recording-to-questionnaire linkage. Full-release behavioural inference requires provenance review; the questionnaire-only spatial analysis is separate.
No failure to reject is interpreted as equivalence or proof of zero effect.
Same-SOA-label Baseline subtraction is not a verified cue-time-matched contrast.
Sigmoid bounds are an explicit reimplementation; saturated R² ceilings independently bound viability.

Four post hoc group sigmoid approximations use one selected extraction/smoothing/fitting pipeline. They do not supply participant boundary inference; bootstrap intervals condition on the chosen method.

The PPS-shape extension compares explicit measured-range shape constraints with equally processed lines using nested participant prediction. Imposed S shapes do not establish empirical curvature or physiological boundaries.
JZS paired-contrast Bayes factors are exploratory and are not a mixed-model Bayes factor.
